item.title: Jeanne des Anges: The Loudun Nun's Own Story
item.description: Urbain Grandier burned in 1634, but the prioress at the heart of the Loudun possessions wrote her own account. It is not what you would expect.

item.title: Palmistry History: The Physician Who Tried to Prove It
item.description: In 1653 a French court physician asked whether palmistry had any basis in medicine. His answer, printed in English in 1658, ends in a remarkable admission.
